settings.content: Cold, clinical palette. Nine Below is a fictional brand built to exercise this theme.

settings.label: Display / headings
settings.info: A grotesque at 700 suits the clinical, modern register. Change here to re-skin.

settings.content: Nine Below sells through BottleNexus, which owns the cart and checkout. This theme renders the BottleNexus buy button and bridges its interactions into GA4 so the funnel is finally measurable.

settings.label: BottleNexus token
settings.info: Placeholder. Paste the real buy-button token here when you go live.

settings.label: Demo mode (simulate the buy flow)
settings.info: Renders a working mock cart and checkout handoff instead of calling BottleNexus, so the full funnel and its GA4 events can be exercised without real credentials. Turn off in production.

settings.label: Buy button label
settings.info: Test alternatives: 'Reserve a Bottle', 'Buy Winter Release'.

settings.label: Display price
settings.info: e.g. 89.00 — leave blank to hide price. Numeric only, no currency symbol.

settings.content: The current gate asks for a full date of birth before anyone sees the product — three inputs standing between a visitor and the page. A single yes/no confirmation is materially less lossy and still satisfies standard trade-body guidance. Confirm your approach with counsel for your markets.

settings.label: Remember for
settings.info: The current site re-gates returning visitors far too often. 30 days cuts repeat friction.

settings.label: Heading
settings.default: You must be at least 21 to purchase alcohol

settings.label: Denial message
settings.default: You're not old enough to view this content.

settings.label: Minimum age
settings.info: Used by the birthdate arm. Kept as one number because this site is US-only; a per-country lookup would change what the test measures.

settings.content: Shown only to visitors bucketed into variant 'b' of the age_gate experiment. Rebuilds the birthdate form that is the category default, so the friction can be measured against the one-tap gate.

settings.label: Heading
settings.default: Are you of legal drinking age?

settings.label: GA4 Measurement ID
settings.info: Placeholder. Paste your own G- ID here. While it stays as G-XXXXXXXXXX the theme runs in analytics demo mode: no network calls are made and every event is logged to the browser console so you can verify the funnel.

settings.label: Debug mode
settings.info: Sends debug_mode so events appear in GA4 DebugView. Turn off in production.

settings.label: Enable Consent Mode v2
settings.info: Bridges Shopify's native cookie banner (Admin → Settings → Customer privacy) into GA4 consent state. This theme does not render its own banner.

settings.label: Consent Mode default
settings.info: US state privacy laws are opt-out: measurement may run until a visitor opts out. EEA/UK require opt-in, so nothing may run before consent. Switch to Denied before selling into Europe. Shopify's banner updates this either way once a visitor chooses.

settings.label: Google Tag Manager ID
settings.info: Optional. GTM-XXXXXXX. Leave blank to load GA4 directly (faster).

settings.label: Klaviyo company ID
settings.info: Leave blank to use the built-in demo signup handler.

settings.content: Assignment runs before first paint, so visitors never see a flash of the wrong variant. Arms are sticky per visitor and every GA4 event carries them, so add_to_cart and begin_checkout split by arm with no extra tooling.

settings.label: Experiments (JSON)
settings.info: One key per experiment. The FIRST variant listed is the control. `traffic` is the percentage of visitors admitted — the rest see the control and are excluded from reporting. Set `enabled: false` to park an experiment without deleting it. Invalid JSON disables all tests rather than breaking the page.

settings.content: Force an arm with ?ab=hero_headline:b (comma-separate for several). Clear with ?ab=reset. Forced arms persist, so you can walk a whole funnel in one variant. In the console: NBAB.all(), NBAB.force('id','b'), NBAB.reset().

A stripped landing mode for ad traffic. Nav, footer links and secondary CTAs are removed so the only path is the buy button — every other link is an exit you already paid for. Compliance elements (age gate, responsibility statement, privacy and terms links) are never hidden.

Which platform sent the visitor, resolved from utm_source, the referrer, or the in-app browser. Drives per-channel copy, per-channel styling, and lets an experiment be scoped to one platform with "channel": "tt" in the experiment JSON.

settings.label: Facebook aliases
settings.info: Comma separated, matched against utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign and the referring domain. Aliases of two characters or fewer are only used for exact matches.

settings.content: Force the stripped view with ?flow=focus, or force the full site with ?flow=full. The mode persists for the session.

settings.label: Sticky mobile buy bar
settings.info: Keeps the buy action reachable on phones. Typically one of the largest single mobile conversion gains.
